display_name: 遮挡先验源域同记录结构诊断
description: 固定遮挡先验、随机同架构对照与 DURA，在同 RX 和源场景组内比较 received/DURA 与 clean 的同记录检索。
authorization: User authorizes ongoing Phase1 F-free restoration research, source-only diagnostics and GPU use.

code.environment: N607 CPU, 2 threads, CUDA disabled, nice 10

data.representation: 672 fixed source pilot paired received/clean IQ, frozen DURA output
data.contract_ref: docs/PROJECT_PROTOCOL.md: 恢复器主测试口径及源数据权限
data.physical_ids_ref: 672 previously explored source pilot IDs disjoint from 32768 prior fit IDs

roles.L_s: source IQ pair, no TX identity
roles.U_s: source IQ pair, TX identity hidden

data.validation_ref: Previously explored 672 source pilot; not an independent blind test
data.leo_config_ref: Source fixed epoch19 seven simulated views

permissions.claim_scope: Same-record retrieval only; may exploit packet or receiver cues, not TX identity or target accuracy

checkpoint.initialization: Fixed source-only masked IQ prior final epoch five and original DURA
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Prior and DURA source-only provenance verified; 32768 prior fit IDs disjoint from pilot
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Fixed original DURA source-only provenance previously verified
checkpoint.selection_rule: Fixed DURA and prior final epoch; no target access

execution.gpu_policy: CPU only 2 threads, nice 10, preserve all existing owners
execution.stop_rule: Stop on source role mismatch, nonfinite output or loss, target/F/TX access or technical failure; do not change other jobs

expected_artifacts: result.json: grouped source same-record retrieval and feature statistics

metric_names: same-record top1 within source RX and scene
dimensions: public RX x seven source views
masked prior, random same architecture, raw IQ
metrics_plan.scorer_ref: none; no target or TX truth

rows.method: Fixed central 32-point mask; prior hidden mean/std, random network and raw IQ cosine retrieval
rows.purpose: Measure source record-level information across received/DURA and clean without transmitter labels
rows.seed_notes: Five epochs, fixed final epoch; source pilot mask seed independent
rows.scenario: fixed previously explored source pilot grouped by RX and source simulation view
rows.budget_ref: 8-record real-checkpoint CPU smoke and 672 source records, batch16, no training
expected_artifacts: result.json: grouped source same-record retrieval and feature statistics

notes: No F weights/outputs, TX labels, V, target IQ/truth or parameter updates.
Same-record source matches may exploit packet content or receiver details; they are not transmitter identity accuracy.
Random comparison uses a fixed independent initialization of the same architecture, not the prior original initialization.
Prior source fit IDs exclude pilot, but pilot was previously explored and may overlap original DURA source ancestry.
